title: Bobiverse vessels — hulls, design generations, and other craft

id.description: Stable key. Holotank plates hang on vessels/<id>.

name.description: Display name as the registry shows it.

kind.description: design = a generation of plans; hull = a named ship; class = a type without a single hull id; weapon = death rocks and the like when the books treat them as craft.

line.description: Fleet family for sorting and filters later.

generation.description: Heaven design generation when kind is design (or a hull is known to that gen). Not the same as the hull name Heaven-N.

design.description: id of a design entry this hull or class is built from, when known.

match.description: Exact string as stored on bobs.json vessel field, so a Bob dossier can link here. One vessel per match string.

crew.description: Bob ids associated with this vessel (flew it, built it, briefed from it).

cite.description: Chapter or appendix that establishes this entry.

spoil.description: Latest book the entry's own note draws on, same rule as other companion registers.
